cases.question: Average MonthlyCharges by Contract
cases.sql: SELECT Contract, AVG(MonthlyCharges) AS avg_MonthlyCharges FROM data GROUP BY Contract ORDER BY avg_MonthlyCharges DESC;

cases.question: Total customers by InternetService
cases.sql: SELECT InternetService, COUNT(customerID) AS total_customers FROM data GROUP BY InternetService ORDER BY total_customers DESC;

cases.question: Highest MonthlyCharges by PaymentMethod
cases.sql: SELECT PaymentMethod, MAX(MonthlyCharges) AS max_monthly_charges FROM data GROUP BY PaymentMethod ORDER BY max_monthly_charges DESC

cases.question: Average tenure by gender
cases.sql: SELECT gender, AVG(tenure) AS average_tenure FROM data GROUP BY gender ORDER BY average_tenure DESC;

cases.question: Total count of customers with Partner = 'Yes'
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(customerID) AS count FROM data WHERE Partner = 'Yes';

cases.question: Average TotalCharges for PhoneService = 'Yes'
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(TotalCharges) AS avg_total_charges FROM data WHERE PhoneService = 'Yes';

cases.question: Count of customers grouped by Dependents
cases.sql: SELECT Dependents, COUNT(customerID) AS count FROM data GROUP BY Dependents ORDER BY count DESC

cases.question: Average MonthlyCharges by PaperlessBilling
cases.sql: SELECT PaperlessBilling, AVG(MonthlyCharges) AS avg_monthly_charges FROM data GROUP BY PaperlessBilling ORDER BY avg_monthly_charges DESC;

cases.question: Count of customers where tenure > 50
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(customerID) AS count FROM data WHERE tenure > 50

cases.question: Average MonthlyCharges for Contract = 'Two year'
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(MonthlyCharges) AS avg_monthly_charges FROM data WHERE Contract = 'Two year';

cases.question: Total customers grouped by Contract
cases.sql: SELECT Contract, COUNT(customerID) AS total_customers FROM data GROUP BY Contract ORDER BY total_customers DESC;

cases.question: Average tenure for SeniorCitizen = 1
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(tenure) AS average_tenure FROM data WHERE SeniorCitizen = 1;

cases.question: Count of customers with tenure between 12 and 24
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(customerID) FROM data WHERE tenure >= 12 AND tenure <= 24;

cases.question: Average MonthlyCharges for tenure >= 60
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(MonthlyCharges) AS avg_monthly_charges FROM data WHERE tenure >= 60

cases.question: Count of customers with tenure < 6
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(customerID) AS count FROM data WHERE tenure < 6;

cases.question: Total customers where MonthlyCharges > 75.0
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM data WHERE MonthlyCharges > 75.0

cases.question: Average MonthlyCharges for tenure = 1
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(MonthlyCharges) AS avg_monthly_charges FROM data WHERE tenure = 1

cases.question: Total customers with tenure >= 1 and tenure <= 12
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(customerID) FROM data WHERE tenure >= 1 AND tenure <= 12;

cases.question: Total count of High Value Customers
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_value_customer_count FROM data WHERE CAST(TotalCharges AS FLOAT) > 5000;

cases.question: Now break down by Contract
cases.sql: SELECT Contract, COUNT(*) AS high_value_customer_count FROM data WHERE TotalCharges > 5000 GROUP BY Contract ORDER BY high_value_customer_count DESC

cases.question: Only for SeniorCitizen = 1
cases.sql: SELECT Contract, COUNT(*) AS high_value_customer_count FROM data WHERE SeniorCitizen = 1 AND CAST(TotalCharges AS REAL) > 5000 GROUP BY Contract ORDER BY high_value_customer_count DESC

cases.question: Count of Churn Risk Customers
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(customerID) AS count FROM data WHERE Contract = 'Month-to-month' AND tenure <= 6

cases.question: Group by PaymentMethod
cases.sql: SELECT PaymentMethod, COUNT(*) AS count FROM data WHERE Contract = 'Month-to-month' AND tenure <= 6 GROUP BY PaymentMethod ORDER BY count DESC

cases.question: Average MonthlyCharges of High Value Customers
cases.sql: SELECT AVG(MonthlyCharges) AS avg_monthly_charges FROM data WHERE CAST(TotalCharges AS FLOAT) > 5000;

cases.question: Customers with MonthlyCharges > 99999999
cases.sql: SELECT customerID, gender, SeniorCitizen, Partner, Dependents, tenure, PhoneService, MultipleLines, InternetService, OnlineSecurity, OnlineBackup, DeviceProtection, TechSupport, StreamingTV, StreamingMovies, Contract, PaperlessBilling, PaymentMethod, MonthlyCharges, TotalCharges, Churn FROM data WHERE MonthlyCharges > 99999999

cases.question: Total customers with tenure > 500
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(customerID) AS total_customers FROM data WHERE tenure > 500;
